D005-D010_h001.question:
Lately, it feels like I'm living in a nightmare. For the past two months, everything has just been... off. It started about six weeks ago when I got this terrifying feeling that the world was about to collapse. Not just my world, but the actual planet. I'd be editing wedding photos, and all I could see were these dark, shadowy figures in the corners of my vision. They’d just stand there, watching me, sometimes they’d look like warped reflections of wedding guests.

Initially, I barely slept; I had so much energy I thought I could work for days without stopping, convinced these photos were the most important art ever made. I was spending thousands on equipment, convinced I was about to revolutionize photography. But then these visions became more real, the shadows started gesturing, and the feeling that everything was ending became overwhelming. The part that really scares me now is that these terrifying visions, and the belief that the world is ending, only happen when I'm feeling this intense, unstoppable energy, like I am now. When I had that crash a few weeks back, when I couldn't get out of bed for days, they completely disappeared. It's like they're tied to this high.
D005-D010_h001.options:
A. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    B. Acute Stress Disorder
    C. Schizophrenia
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
D005-D010_h001.answer: A. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

D005-D010_h002.question: Lately, everything feels... off. For about two months now, my mind's been racing, and I can barely sleep, maybe three, four hours tops, but I feel wired, not tired. I’ve been convinced that a catastrophic earthquake is coming, not just to our city, but to the entire world, and I’m the only one who can see the signs. I’ve started seeing things too – shadowy figures at the edge of my vision and sometimes, when I'm alone in a room, I see people I know, perfectly clear, just standing there, then they vanish. It's truly terrifying. This overwhelming energy, this constant thought that the world is ending, and these eerie sights, it all started around the same time, when I got this surge of energy and my mood just went through the roof. Before this, I’d never experienced anything like it; these visions and the feeling that everything is crumbling around us only started when I became so manic.

    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features

D005-D010_h003.question:
I’m coming to see you today because things have been really out of control lately. For the past two months, I’ve been feeling really strange. It all started with this incredible burst of energy, like I could conquer anything. I barely slept, sometimes just an hour or two, and I'd be up, pacing my apartment, feeling absolutely brilliant. My thoughts would just race, jumping from one amazing idea to the next. I even started several new business plans, convinced I was on the verge of something huge, even though I haven't been able to hold down a job.

But then these other things started happening, right when I was feeling so wired. I became utterly convinced that my ex-girlfriend, who I haven't seen in months, was cheating on me. I'd go through her old social media, interpreting every post as a coded message. And it wasn't just that—I’ve also started feeling things on my skin, like bugs crawling all over me, or a light touch when no one is there. These crawling sensations are really unsettling, but they only happen when I'm feeling this intense, speeding-up kind of energy. It’s like all these weird perceptions and ideas are part of the same surge of feeling incredibly powerful and on edge.

D005-D010_h024.question:
"Lately, life has just been a whirlwind, and not in a good way. It started about three months ago. I've been feeling this intense euphoria, this boundless energy that just takes over. I can go days with barely any sleep, working on auction plans, contacting clients at all hours. My wife says I’m manic, and she’s probably right, but it feels more like I’m finally seeing things clearly.

But with this energy, there's also been this... unsettling feeling. I'm convinced that rival auction houses are out to sabotage me. I see them in my peripheral vision, always watching. I’ve even felt crawling sensations on my skin, like bugs, but when I look, there's nothing there. It only happens when I’m in this elevated state, though – those creepy sensations and the feeling of being watched, they disappear when my mood settles a bit. And when my wife tries to get me to do something, or even just talks to me, sometimes I just freeze up, like I can’t move or even respond. It’s like my body isn’t my own."
D005-D010_h024.options:
A. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
    B. Schizophrenia
    C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
D005-D010_h024.answer: C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

D005-D010_h025.question:
Lately, it feels like my body isn't my own. I'm convinced my ovaries have shriveled up, even though the doctor says everything is fine. There's this awful smell, like burning hair, that only I can detect, and it's driving me absolutely mad. Sometimes, people stare at me on the street because, without even realizing it, I'll find myself clutching my stomach or twisting my hands in strange ways. It's been going on for about three months now, these bizarre feelings and smells.

But it’s not just that. For the past month, I’ve had this incredible energy. I've been writing an entire musical, sleeping only an hour or two a night, and my mind just races with ideas. I feel like I could conquer the world! My husband says I'm talking a mile a minute and getting unusually agitated. It's during these times, when I'm buzzing with this intense, creative charge, that those odd body sensations and that phantom smell really appear and get worse. It all seems to happen together – the soaring highs and then the strange things about my body and those smells.
D005-D010_h025.options:
A. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
    B. Schizophrenia
    C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
D005-D010_h025.answer: C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
